root_cause: A leaderboard request could start on the pre-run lobby, capture the old leaderboard DOM node, then continue while the Tower replaced that lobby with the run.
When the run ended, the new lobby created fresh loading placeholders, but the old request still painted the detached old node.
For the season ranking, rankBusy could also reject the fresh post-run load while the stale pre-run request was still in progress.
The Wednesday ranking had the same stale-node race without a busy/reload handoff.
changes: Leaderboard painters now resolve the currently mounted DOM node at paint time instead of keeping an obsolete node reference.
Season ranking queues one guaranteed reload when a request arrives while rankBusy is true.
Wednesday ranking now has the same busy/reload handoff.
Starting a run clears the lobby warmup guard so the next post-run lobby can always schedule fresh ranking work.
